t: This top-end sender module operates very much like the $(l:modules/sender_3)Sender Mk2/$, but can send to any inventory (in any dimension) with no restrictions!$(p)Note: the target inventory must be chunk-loaded; $(modr) will not do this for you.
这个顶级发送模块的工作方式与$(l:modules/sender_3)发送模块2型/$非常相似，但它可以不受限制地向任意容器（任意维度）发送物品！$(p)注意：目标容器所在区块必须保持加载；$(modr) 不会替你完成这一点。
